host.scope: current kernel and calling process; cpuset and PID namespace may be sandbox-restricted
limitations: PREEMPT_RT kernel does not imply SCHED_FIFO/RR for the control thread
pinning a CPU is not exclusive-core isolation; SMT sibling may remain busy
governor label alone does not specify current CPU frequency or performance
host compute and local DDS Write durations do not measure motor execution latency

core.state: measured q,dq; previous solution only warm-starts optimization
core.tracking_offset_model: light pitch and yaw centering represented by exact input-coordinate substitution

cost.linear_velocity_semantics: v_E-v_IMU = omega_IMU x r_IMU_E + J_v*dq; fixed H0
cost.linear_velocity_target: zero relative to translating IMU origin, not zero world speed

inverse_dynamics.friction_compensation: none; do not transfer simulation friction

core.forward_model: conditional rigid right arm with observed moving torso, not full-body contact dynamics
unmodelled: physical friction and payload inertia error
core.output_semantics: a includes modeled pitch and yaw feedback; packet tau=(M*a+b)-PD, device adds PD once

shoulder_yaw_execution.semantics: fixed nominal packet q/dq; PD modeled inside prediction, not added after final torque check

planning_actuation_constraints.semantics: absolute total/feedforward limits inside the acceleration MPC; no torque-rate rows
planning_actuation_constraints.local_model: current conditional arm mass and bias frozen across 54 ms horizon

predictive_braking.semantics: soft horizon cost plus latched first-action braking; no abort gate

core.torque_mapping: direct M*a+b; one final affine consistency/envelope check; no candidate search

yaw_feedback_prediction.acceleration_limits_apply_to: net model acceleration including yaw PD

predictor_manifest.features: qf[0:12], dqf[0:12], H0 filtered acc/omega/alpha; standardize then IMU scale0.5
predictor_manifest.target_contract: acc/alpha left interval samples h-6,h-4,h-2ms; omega/rpy endpoint h
predictor_manifest.filter_caveat: Future FILTERED estimates, not raw instantaneous acceleration. No fixed time advance or delay compensation.
predictor_manifest.alpha_contract: 15Hz causal lowpass of backward difference of 15Hz filtered omega on 2ms grid
predictor_manifest.innovation: weighted historical future + decay[h,group]*(current - weighted historical current)
predictor_manifest.rotation_adapter: Measured node0 R; world-left SO3 exponential integration of trapezoidal predicted omega. RPY forecasts diagnostic only.
predictor_manifest.frame: fixed H0 yaw reference per run; torso IMU origin; gravity [0,0,-9.81]
predictor_manifest.status: Offline-fitted candidate; no claim of hardware MPC or raw-impact validation.

preflight.limitations: offline compatibility only; not a 6 ms field or closed-loop performance certificate
